Grouper contract

Source: R/clustering.R
grouper-contract.Rd

All groupers in this package share one signature so they are drop-in replaceable in clean_pseudo_spectra() and process_pseudo_spec():

Details


  function(mz, intensity = NULL, target_mz = NULL, scan = NULL, ms1_int = NULL)

Only mz is required; each grouper ignores the arguments it does not use. process_pseudo_spec() calls the grouper once per feature, on the MS2 centroids of all samples pooled together, passing mz (fragment m/z), intensity (centroid intensity) and target_mz (precursor m/z). scan and ms1_int are not passed there; they exist for custom callers.

Because samples are pooled, the tolerance has to cover between-sample calibration drift as well as within-sample scatter.

A grouper returns an integer vector, one group id per element of mz, with no more distinct ids than distinct mz values. Check a custom grouper with validate_grouper().
